llm_reason: R2 mechanical evaluation: all five candidates plate at 4C (anode min -0.18 to -0.29 V) with tiny 4C charge acceptance (0.08-0.19 Ah); T_max 348-356 K at h=10; SEI passes (449/405 nm <= 500). Plateau still fails everywhere (~3.9 V, material gap). R3 tests the in-boundary extremes: (1) the most transport-friendly architecture possible - if it also plates, 4C-without-plating is unreachable in the locked electrolyte/system boundary (electrolyte formulation is a Stage-2 material lever, locked by the ablation note); (2) h=25 to quantify whether passive smartphone cooling can hold T_max <= 323.15 K.
